numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.function_vd.StatsFunctionsOfVariableDimension¶

class numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.function_vd.StatsFunctionsOfVariableDimension(t_span, stepsize=1, t_eval=None, order=2, collect_jump_times=False, collect_dimension_jump_times=False)¶

A class to compute and store statistics of functions of variable dimension.

evaluated_functions¶

Count of the functions evaluated.

Type:

int

times¶

A list of time points for evaluations.

Type:

list

order¶

A list of orders for norms to be computed.

Type:

list

norm_means¶

Means of the norms for each order over time. The array has the shape (len(order), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

norm_variances¶

Sample variances of the norms for each order over time. The array has the shape (len(order), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

norm_m2¶

Sum of squared differences of the norms for each order over time. The array has the shape (len(order), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

dimension_means¶

Means of the dimension over time. The array has the length len(times).

Type:

np.ndarray

dimension_variances¶

Sample variances of the dimension over time. The array has the length len(times).

Type:

np.ndarray

dimension_m2¶

Sum of squared differences of the dimension for each order over time. The array has the length len(times).

Type:

np.ndarray

custom_evaluation_functions¶

List of user-provided functions to evaluate.

Type:

list of callables

cef_means¶

Means of the custom evaluation functions over time. The array has the shape (len(custom_evaluation_functions), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

cef_variances¶

Sample variances of the custom evaluation functions over time. The array has the shape (len(custom_evaluation_functions), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

cef_m2¶

Sum of squared differences of the custom evaluation functions over time. The array has the shape (len(custom_evaluation_functions), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

collect_jump_times¶

Indicates whether jump times are stored.

Type:

bool

jump_times¶

List of all jump times of evaluated functions. Exists only, when collect_jump_times is True.

Type:

list of lists

collect_dimension_jump_times¶

Indicates whether dimension jump times are stored.

Type:

bool

dimension_jump_times¶

List of all dimension jump times of evaluated functions. Exists only, when collect_dimension_jump_times is True.

Type:

list of lists

__init__(t_span, stepsize=1, t_eval=None, order=2, collect_jump_times=False, collect_dimension_jump_times=False)¶

Initializes the statistics collector.

Parameters:

  • t_span (tuple) – The start and end times for evaluations.

  • stepsize (float, optional) – The step size for time evaluations.

  • t_eval (list or array-like, optional) – Specific times at which to evaluate the functions.

  • order (int, list or array-like, optional) – The order(s) of the norm(s) to compute.

  • collect_jump_times (bool, optional) – If True, collect jump times during evaluation.

  • collect_dimension_jump_times (bool, optional) – If True, collect dimension jump times during evaluation.

add_custom_evaluation_function(func)¶

Adds a custom evaluation function to be evaluated later.

Parameters:

func (callable) – The custom evaluation function to add.

Raises:

ValueError – If functions have already been added.

add_function(func)¶

Adds a function to the statistics collector for evaluation.

Parameters:

func (FunctionOfVariableDimension) – The function to add and evaluate.

Raises:

  • TypeError – If func is not a function of variable dimension.

  • ValueError – If the function’s time range does not match the collector’s.

static list_difference(list1, list2)¶

Remove list1 from list2 if it is a sublist.

Parameters:

  • list1 (list of lists) – List that contains the elements to be removed.

  • list2 (list of lists) – List where the elements from list1 should be removed from.

Returns:

result – List that contains all elements in list2, but not in list1, accounting for multiple entrances.

Return type:

list

Raises:

ValueError – If list1 is not a sublist of list2.
